text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Do you know what is essential to craft
a truly splendid puppet show?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: That would be—the puppets!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And so, Bright-san!
Would you craft a puppet of me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, a puppet of Opera O-sama~?
Of course, I would be delighted~.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I shall provide you with some candid photos of myself as reference material!
I have about 120 gigabytes worth. Put them to good use!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, but I tend to do things rather slowly.
Who knows when it will ever be finished~?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... In that case, I shall assist you.
Dividing the work should expedite its completion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-sama~.
The puppet's outfit is coming along nicely~.
How are things on your end~?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah-hah-hah-hah!
This has turned out to be quite the formidable adversary.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No, of course it is marvelous! After all, it is
a doll brought to life by my own hands! However—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —It falls sorely short of expressing my radiant beauty!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Alas... What a torment I am to artists!
To think that being so excessively beautiful, even my own hands
cannot fully reproduce my essence...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~. Shall I do my best with
the face as well then~?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Once I resolve to do something, I do not go back on my word.
Therefore, first—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah-hah-hah-hah! Did you witness that, Bright-san?!
Dart-throwing precision as exquisite as threading a needle!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Right dead center in one go~. Splendid as always~.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Wunderbar!! What a supreme Singspiel!
My inspiration surges!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes~.
Both your acting and your singing were wonderful~.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Haah! Dancing like a sovereign conqueror!
Beautiful as an angel, that is I!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Go, go~. Please keep doing your best~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...By the way, what have you been up to
these past few days, Opera O-sama~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the academy grounds,
I saw TM Opera O staggering unsteadily.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No need for concern... To craft a puppet that even
Hoffmann would yearn for, staying up late is a small price to pay.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: And thanks to undergoing my Sovereign Training Regimen—behold!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah-hah-hah-hah!
How do you find this beautiful version of myself?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I completed it with Bright-san's assistance!
It took eight attempts, but I have finally triumphed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she didn't lose heart even after failing seven times.
My honest thoughts slipped out before I could stop them.
choice_data_list: ...Your refusal to give up is truly impressive, isn't it?
...Your refusal to give up is truly impressive, huh?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, naturally.
Giving up does not suit me in the least.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Because you fail repeatedly, the next attempt will also fail—
why think that way? Who decides such a future?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I believe in myself. Even if the next attempt
is the 10th, the 100th, or the 1,000th...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —The next time will be the one. I shall see it through to victory.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now! With this puppet in hand,
let us go meet our friends.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: They must bestow their praise upon the splendid replica of myself I have created! Haaah-hah-hah-hah!
